name: Erinna
bio: Erinna is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to c. 600 BC. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of Meleager's Wreath, the Garland compiled about 100 BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the first volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Books I–VI) (Book VI: 352).

poems.title: Book VI, 352
poems.author: Erinna
poems.text: This picture is the work of delicate hands; ‘so, good Prometheus, there are men whose skill is equal to thine. At least if he who painted this girl thus to the life had but added speech, she would be, Agatharchis, your complete self.
